died.name: Mary Rich, Countess of Warwick
died.last_words: Well, ladies, if I were one hour in heaven, I would not be again with you, as much as I love you.

died.name: Pietro Metastasio
died.last_words: I offer to Thee, O Lord, Thy own Son, who already has given the pledge of love, inclosed in this thin emblem; turn on Him thine eyes; oh! behold whom I offer to Thee and then desist, O Lord! if thou canst desist from mercy.

died.name: Adoniram Judson
died.desc: American Congregationalist and Particular Baptist missionary
died.cause: dying at sea in the Bay of Bengal. Judson was buried at sea
died.last_words: Brother Ranney, will you bury me? bury me?-quick! quick! Take care of poor mistress.

died.name: Clara Barton
died.desc: American nurse and founder of the American Red Cross
died.last_words: Let me go! Let me go!

died.name: Maj. Kenneth D. McCullar
died.cause: The 27-year-old member of the 64th Bombardment Squadron was taking off for a night mission in New Guinea when he struck something with his bomber, referred to in reports as a "brush kangaroo" or "baby kangaroo" and later found to be a wallaby. The bomber crashed on takeoff, which detonated its load of bombs, killing McCullar and the rest of the bomber's crew.

died.name: Josephine Baker
died.last_words: Oh, you young people act like old men. You are no fun.

died.name: Abbie Hoffman
died.cause: in note written prior to phenobarbital overdose
died.last_words: It's too late. We can't win, they've gotten too powerful.

died.name: John Lewis
died.cause: The 64-year-old businessman from Minsterworth, attempted to light a bonfire with gasoline, but inadvertently set his clothes on fire. He then ran to the River Severn, jumped in, and eventually drowned. His body was not found until 30 April 1999.

born.name: Eben Byers
born.cause: The 51-year-old American socialite and industrialist died after drinking excessive quantities of Radithor, a patent medicine that contained 2 microcuries of radium. He drank a total of around 1400 doses, which concentrated in his bones, continually irradiating him. By 1931, his bones were reportedly disintegrating and his jaw had been removed; he died the next year.

born.name: Tiny Tim
born.desc: American musician, ukulele player and musical archivist
born.cause: to his wife after she asked if he was alright, right before collapsing on stage during a performance of "Tip-Toe Through the Tulips"
